Executive Order 7738 of November 11, 1937 amends paragraph 6 of Subdivision VII of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules, under paragraph Eighth, subdivision SECOND, section 2 of the Civil Service Act (22 Stat. 403, 404), to read as follows, and the paragraph it installs covers temporary clerks, carriers and laborers for part-time or intermittent Postal Service work in connection with holiday or seasonal business from November 15, 1937 to January 15, 1938. The held text is the Federal Register print as machine-extracted from the official PDF (2 FR 2867, PDF pages 1-1); it is one order with one operative paragraph and the closing number [No. 7738]. The command (to amend the paragraph) was carried out on signing, and the rule text it installed names its own window, which closes on January 15, 1938; that day is recorded inclusive under research/readiness/owner_rulings/2026-10-21-until-and-further-exempt.md, and the exclusive reading (the window closes when that day begins) is the alternative. The packet records no later event for this order (chain empty, OFR catalog search zero hits).
